title.hr: Prelijevanje: količina ostaje, razina se mijenja
title.en: Pouring: the amount stays, the level changes

concept.hr: Ista voda u uskoj posudi stoji više, a u širokoj niže
concept.en: The same water stands higher in a narrow vessel and lower in a wide one

summary.hr: Prelijevaj vodu iz posude u posudu, pogodi koja prima više, napuni vrč šalicu po šalicu, čitaj litre i decilitre.
summary.en: Pour water between vessels, guess which holds more, fill a jug cup by cup, read litres and decilitres.

concept.hr: Dvije posude uspoređujemo prelijevanjem iz pune u praznu
concept.en: Two vessels are compared by pouring a full one into an empty one

concept.hr: Koliko šalica napuni vrč: manja posuda, veći broj
concept.en: How many cups fill a jug: a smaller vessel, a bigger number

concept.hr: Boce od 1 l punimo decilitar po decilitar: 23 dl = 2 l 3 dl
concept.en: Filling 1 l bottles decilitre by decilitre: 23 dl = 2 l 3 dl
